skill.displayName: Amazon 商品详情【Gecho 官方】

llm.summary: The skill is coherent for Amazon product collection, but it asks users to install unpinned third-party Gecho components that can run and persist in the local agent environment.

dimensions.detail: The workflow depends on a Chrome extension, a Gecho account, and a logged-in Amazon browser session, which is proportionate to the task but sensitive enough that users should understand what session data the external component can access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup instructions use npx -y @gecho-ai/gecho-bridge@latest and unpinned OpenClaw plugin install/update commands, so the reviewed artifact does not fix the code version that will run.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill strongly requires use of the Gecho amazon_product tool and adds Gecho support links on failures; this is vendor-specific but disclosed and tied to the skill's stated workflow.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The MCP and plugin setup commands modify OpenClaw/Hermes configuration and restart the gateway, meaning the external component may remain available across future sessions until removed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches the instructions: collect Amazon product details through the Gecho Bridge MCP and a logged-in Chrome/Amazon session.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this before installing. Only use it if you trust the Gecho publisher and are comfortable connecting an external MCP/Chrome extension workflow to a logged-in Amazon browser session. Prefer pinned, reviewed versions of the MCP package and bundle, and consider using a separate browser profile or low-privilege environment.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-language orientation is visible in the artifact, but it is a usability/localization issue rather than evidence of unsafe behavior.
[T01] expected: The Gecho-only tool routing and support-link behavior are vendor-specific and somewhat restrictive, but they are disclosed and aligned with a skill whose purpose is to use Gecho Bridge rather than arbitrary Amazon scraping.
[T08] unexpected: The unpinned npx @latest MCP command creates a real supply-chain review gap because future package contents can differ from the reviewed artifact.
[T08] unexpected: The unpinned OpenClaw bundle install and update commands can activate an external component whose source and exact version are not present in the artifact.
